title: Ingest has no telemetry beyond a single run row
description: collection_runs holds one row with a free-text note and no outcome column. There is no per-repo scan record, no rate-limit accounting, no asset-verification result, and no freshness signal. An operator cannot tell whether ingest is healthy, stalled, or failing — it has in fact been stalled since 2026-07-28.
acceptance_criteria: Each run records outcome, counts of repos queued/scanned/failed, files added/retired, and asset verification results. Freshness and coverage are queryable in one statement.

title: Every cdn_url is pinned to a mutable branch instead of a commit sha
description: All 35,509 cdn_url values are pinned to a branch (@main / @master); zero are pinned to a commit sha, even though font_files.sha is populated for every row. Branch pins rot silently when upstream restructures, and jsDelivr caches branch pins aggressively. Verified: the AnonymousPro/Bold/ path used by nerd-fonts rows no longer exists on master.
acceptance_criteria: cdn_url is built from an immutable commit sha. A human-facing branch URL may be kept as a separate field. Backfill converts existing rows.

title: 1909 cdn_url values contain raw unencoded spaces
description: 1,909 font_files rows store a cdn_url with literal spaces, e.g. https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts@master/src/unpatched-fonts/AnonymousPro/Bold/Anonymous Pro B.ttf . curl rejects the value outright (exit 3 / status 000). The stored string is not a valid URL and is emitted directly into @font-face src.
acceptance_criteria: Path segments are percent-encoded when the URL is built at ingest. A data-quality check asserts zero stored URLs contain characters outside the unreserved/encoded set. Existing rows are backfilled.

title: 30 fonts exceed the jsDelivr size limit and return 403
description: 30 font_files exceed 20 MiB and 2 exceed 50 MiB (max 99,759,400 bytes, ctrlcctrlv/TT2020 TT2020StyleG-Regular.ttf). Verified live: jsDelivr returns HTTP 403 for both a 95 MB ttf and a 30 MB ttc, while a normal file returns 206. These rows are advertised as renderable and cannot load.
acceptance_criteria: Ingest applies a CDN size policy, records why a file is not CDN-servable, and falls back to raw_url or excludes the row from renderable output. No public renderable row points at a URL that returns a non-2xx.

title: Ingest is a one-shot bulk load with no incremental path
description: collection_runs contains exactly one row (started 2026-07-28T23:11Z, finished 01:32Z, workers=38, cap=1000000, unique_count=12782, note 'loaded from data/all.json'). sources rows all belong to run 1. There is no scheduled or incremental ingest, so no font published after 2026-07-28 can ever enter the catalog.
acceptance_criteria: A scheduled ingest runs on a defined cadence, records a new collection_runs row per run with started/finished/outcome, and discovers repos created or updated since the previous watermark.

title: Font ingestion pipeline resilience
description: The catalog DB is populated by an external one-shot collector (collection_runs id=1, note 'loaded from data/all.json', 2026-07-28). No ingest code exists in this repository. Evidence gathered 2026-08-02 shows the pipeline is stalled and produces assets that fail to load. This epic covers making font ingestion resumable, idempotent, verified, and observable.
acceptance_criteria: Every child issue closed; INV-INGEST-* invariants added to INVARIANTS.md with regression tests; a scheduled ingest run completes and reports coverage, error, and asset-health metrics.

title: Only 165 of 12782 repos have ever been font-scanned
description: repos.fonts_scanned_at is NULL for 12,617 of 12,782 rows (98.7%). Only 140 repos actually have font_files. 10,706 repos that are fontish, non-fork, non-archived and OFL-1.1 licensed have never been scanned. The public catalog therefore exposes ~1% of the collected corpus. v_repos_missing_fonts has 10,810 rows and nothing consumes it.
acceptance_criteria: A resumable scan worker drains v_repos_missing_fonts; coverage of OFL-eligible repos reaches >95%; progress is checkpointed so an interrupted run resumes without rescanning completed repos.
